verdict.rationale: PlanetScale is a hosted/managed database platform; there is no evidence of a self-hostable core product, and a community comment explicitly confirms it cannot be installed locally, used offline, or is not open source ('Can I install this locally?... the answer to all three questions is no'). The 'PlanetScale Managed' bring-your-own-cloud option (docs-47) is still a managed service, not self-hosting.
